notes.title: Alix Demo 0.1.7 update (beta4) 🧑‍🔧✨
notes.content: [p]This fourth beta of the 0.1.7 release focuses on 2 training areas to learn how the player can collaborate with Woody the fox. Feel free to report any issue using the internal BugReporter, on my discord server [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE"]https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE[/url] or on bluesky [url="https://bsky.app/profile/oxeron.com"]https://bsky.app/profile/oxeron.com[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/deb8be90b498a11c6564574579efdb6a2bb1e1e1.png"][/img]New features[/h3][list][*][p]Add a cutscene for market path now included in the demo (yet)[/p][/*][*][p]2 new areas to learn how to summon Woody, take control, and use his abilities[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/33c294754c076bab5c57059306bbdedec4a7069b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/3cca0244caf4eff1ffd9ddd833f22773ef92c390.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Add buttons on screen (joypads and keyboard)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changed features[/h3][list][*][p]A lot of elements now monitor Woody in addition to the player (stairs, interruptors, chests, coins, traps, …)[/p][/*][*][p]Migration of level saved files[/p][/*][*][p]Peagons are afraid of Woody 🙂[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]No new bugfix included[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known issues[/h3][list][*][p]No known issue[/p][/*][/list][h3]Coming next[/h3][list][*][p]Remap keys settings[/p][/*][*][p]More NPC[/p][/*][*][p]Player will be able to start using Woody’s abilities[/p][/*][/list][h3]System and dependencies changes[/h3][list][*][p]None[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Alix Demo 0.1.7 update (beta3) 🧑‍🔧✨
notes.content: [p]This third beta of this 0.1.7 release focuses on quality. I took care of every bug report (more than 200 !!!) you sent via the in-game bugreport. Thanks a lot for your support and feedback, it helps me a lot to improve the game.[/p][p]I still need your help to report issues on this version which includes a lot of addition and modification. Feel free to report using the internal BugReporter, on my discord server [url="https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE"]https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE[/url] or on bluesky notes.title: Alix Demo 0.1.7 update (beta2) 🧑‍🔧✨
notes.content: [p]This second beta of the 0.1.7 release introduces a new boss (the Minotaur), a menu screen (finally!) and a brand new save system. I need your help to report issues on this version which includes a lot of addition and modification. Feel free to report using the internal BugReporter, on the discord server [url="https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE"]https://discord.gg/xfN5n4aNVE[/url] or on bluesky [url="https://bsky.app/profile/oxeron.com"]https://bsky.app/profile/oxeron.com[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]New features[/h3][list][*][p]Minotaur boss[/p][/*][*][p]Title and settings screen, die screen[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now die[/p][/*][*][p]Game save, load and resume. New SaveStone to save progression manually[/p][/*][*][p]New language: German[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/4e349ad2f441b0bd25a25f3466f9e064e65e4b5d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525087/6feb30a79ce3f03200537b4e04dd962d536cd9eb.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]Changed features[/h3][list][*][p]Rework Elya story[/p][/*][*][p]Rework dialog balloon to automatically resize depending on text lenght[/p][/*][*][p]Code optimizations[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]Font issue with some special characters[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of bugs 🪲[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known issues[/h3][list][*][p]Candle management is not optimal[/p][/*][*][p]Sword is still hard to get, a new jauge system will be implemented soon[/p][/*][/list][h3]Coming next[/h3][list][*][p]Pause screen[/p][/*][*][p]Video settings[/p][/*][/list][p]Have a nice day 💌[/p]
